Kain says free AI inference attracts abuse at scale: a startup had to ban an entire country over stolen-card fraud

"My head of engineering was saying, there's this lady that runs a startup, and they give a free trial. You have to put a credit card in. It's some DevOps system, and you get 15 minutes of inference to learn how the system works."

"She literally was on the timeline yesterday being like, 'This is a nightmare. You can't give out free inference.'"

"They banned all of Indonesia. The whole country is banned now, because people were using stolen credit cards to break into this system. Tokens are so fungible that people will steal them from anywhere."

"Anyone who says, 'I'm going to give out some free inference to you,' the optimal play is to go and take that inference and try and find other places where you can steal inference from."

"At the first crack in the thing, you just get this swarm of people flooding in trying to exploit it, because inference begets inference begets inference."

the algorithms that are improving your life are about to learn how to improve themselves. the algorithms that are fucking with your life are about to learn how to improve themselves.

the prospect of investing in something *self-improving*? people will leverage themselves to the tits.

what you need to understand and accept is that bitcoin & crypto isn't this solid thing here. it's more of a moonshot thing again. it's a very digital thing in a world where everything digital is getting a shakedown.

you're almost 40 years old and your digital profession can be done by free open source software made in china run with a handcrank. your wife isn't going to let you gamble with your entire financial future in magical coins when you can't even tell her what your career prospects look like anymore. your beard is patchy.

bitcoin & crypto can still do well in this environment, because when technology, markets and geopolitics become ultra-volatile in unison, you're bound to also get weird market dislocations. you have arms races, you have bubbles popping, you might get lots of money printing. most things that can happen will happen.

you got your funds on an exchange? cool. doesn't feel great either, does it?

oh, but you're not impacted because you choose to hold your exposure through etps/etfs? well, if that's what you have to resolve to, that's not great either.

if you can't be secure with your crypto, if you can't feel safe with it, even though you're a freaking nerd in this industry, how does that bode for the industry at large?

embrace that it will be volatile.

In some ways the new Fable is a monster. This is SimpleQA Verified from Epoch. There are few benchmarks like this where Fable 5.2 jaggedly jumped ahead of the entire pack.

For me there are two big indicators arriving next week that will tell us a lot about the shape of things going into 2027. I'm assuming two things happen next week: Anthropic releases their internal progress report (from which we will get updated numbers on RSI), and OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra.

With the new Astra, we will see how OpenAI answers Fable, and Fable needs to be answered. They need to close the gap, but they also need to close the gap that doesn’t show up on benchmarks: that a lot of people love working with the new Anthropic models, particularly Opus 5.5. And this is starting to tip the table a little.  Also expect another huge math release simultaneously with the new Astra. The previous one took five weeks and produced 700 papers; they've had another five weeks since then. They have also been working on other Millennium problems. Don't be shocked by anything. 

Astra's capability, and if it catches or surpasses Fable, is the first one. The second is where Anthropic is on AL4. The AI Futures Project (the AI 2027 guys) predict that AL4 reached 50% last month. If that's true, that means it will probably hit 80% by January. And at that point, assuming the overall pattern holds, some of the work at Anthropic will be at AL5 - aka fully autonomous with no human input. Probably about 5–10% of work at Anthropic would be at that level. If this number is actually higher than 50%, then things are moving even faster than believed, and that would be a big update for a lot of people, including me, who already has pretty short timelines. Above AL4 50% in October would probably mean RSI before the end of the year. Or possibly, already. So, a very important week for finding out where we are, and where we are headed.
